messages.subject: multidimensional grsmIRT in confirmatory style..
parts:
Hello,

    I am wondering if it's possible to fit multidimensional factor grsmIRT model...

    grsmIRT has to be unidimensional but if it is used in confirmatory setting and let just one factor to be loaded on the items,

    I dont see any reason it shouldn't be used in multidimensional setting

    model should be looking like this,

" F1 = 1-9
F2 = 10-14
F3 = 15-19
COV = F1*F2*F3"

   I tried with eliminating nfact == 1 condition in initializing function

   but I doesn't seem to work...


   Do you have any suggestion?

  KH Kim

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: multidimensional grsmIRT in confirmatory style..
parts:
That's sort of the problem with all the classical IRT parametrizations, they really don't generalize well to multidimensional models (at least, not intuitively or obviously). This is mainly why I use the slope-intercept form wherever possible in all items. So I think for multidimensional models, you should resort to the grsm itemtype. Cheers. 

Phil
